Subject: Consolidated evening technical walkthrough — multi-prospect slot proposal

Hi all,

Thanks again for the interest in a deeper walkthrough of Redwood Inference. Rather than three separate 1:1s, a short consolidated evening session (60 minutes) should surface the core integration points for each of your teams and let us field common questions. Proposed agenda attached.

Proposed time slots (PT):
- Option A: Tue Jun 15, 6:00pm–7:00pm PT
- Option B: Wed Jun 16, 5:00pm–6:00pm PT

Please reply with which option works for you (or suggest up to two alternatives). We’ll run a 40–45 minute demo + 15 minutes for Q&A and follow-ups.

Hosts: Laura Bennett (solutions), with Ben Carter as backup for deep runtime/ops questions. I’ll set the calendar once we have a majority preference.

Attachments: walkthrough-agenda.pdf (high-level topics + links to quickstart).

Looking forward—
Sergio
